name: BPO-Escalations Excel analysis

recommended_action.coding_change_test: CODING_CHANGES_PRESENT=Yes OR CODING_CHANGES_FIELDS has a value OR VOIDED_PROCEDURECODE has a value OR CREATED_PROCEDURECODE has a value
recommended_action.condition_1: For ERA_EOB_POSTED=Yes use ERA_EOB_CODE_PAIRS; for No use the six rejection/previous-action columns. If an approved code is found and coding_change_test is true, output DRPCBOAPPROVE.
recommended_action.condition_2: If an approved code is found and coding_change_test is false, use INFLOW_QUEUE_COUNT. At 0, output one approved source code.
condition_2_exceptions: PREVIOUS_KICKCODETOINFLOW_REMARKCODES ending in 507 plus IRC_GROUP_NAME starting with Medicare outputs CODINGRVW

possible_paper_drop: When ERA_EOB_POSTED=No and IRC_GROUP_NAME contains Blue or Commercial, output Yes.
rework_marker: Output Yes when ERA_EOB_POSTED=Yes, INSURANCEREPORTINGCATEGORYNAME is absent from Non-callable payer List.IRC, and USERNOTES_AFTER_INFLOW contains coded correctly or reach payer.
